sections.text: There are now two ways to be found: be *ranked* or be *cited.*
prose: Your customers increasingly ask their questions directly to AI assistants, which answer in a few lines and cite a handful of sources. If your content isn't clear, structured and trustworthy, those sources will be your competitors.
The good news: GEO builds on the same foundations as good SEO — clarity, structure, expertise — plus a few specific practices that we apply for you.

items.p: Crawling, indexing, speed, structure, duplication and content gaps: a snapshot prioritized by impact.
Keyword and real-question research, then a site structure that answers each intent.
Direct answers at the top of pages, question-and-answer (FAQ) sections, clear definitions and proof so you can be quoted and cited.
schema.org markup (organization, services, FAQ, articles, authors) so engines understand who you are and what you offer.
AI crawler access (robots.txt), an llms.txt file, a consistent entity across the web, identified authors and verifiable sources.
Speed and Core Web Vitals, tracking of rankings, organic traffic and your mentions in AI answers.

sections.h2: Frequently asked questions about *SEO and GEO*

sections.p: Let's review your visibility, on Google and in AI.

a: GEO is the set of practices that make your content understandable, trustworthy and citable by AI-based answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews. It complements traditional SEO.

faq.q: What's the difference between SEO and GEO?
a: SEO aims to rank you in search results. GEO aims to have AI cite you in its answers. Both rely on clear, structured, credible content, but GEO emphasizes direct answers, structured data and a clear company identity.

faq.q: How do I get ChatGPT or Gemini to cite my business?
a: Publish clear, verifiable answers to specific questions, identify your authors and company, add structured data, allow AI crawlers in your robots.txt and maintain a consistent presence elsewhere on the web. No technique guarantees a citation, but these practices increase your chances.

faq.q: Does SEO still work in the age of AI?
a: Yes. Answer engines often rely on the same sources as search engines. A well-structured, fast site rich in useful answers remains the foundation of both.

faq.q: Do you work with SEO experts?
a: Yes. We design your site's structure and content and collaborate with selected SEO experts from our network for ongoing optimization mandates.

faq.q: How long before I see results?
a: SEO and GEO are gradual investments: technical fixes can have a quick effect, while authority and rankings build over time. We track indicators from the start to show progress.
